top_choice_rationale: P001 recognises a genuinely new principle, induced proximity, in which a small molecule adaptor makes a ubiquitin ligase remove a chosen protein; the mechanism is physically well defined (ternary-complex formation and lifetime set degradation rates), independently reproduced, and opens targets without an occupiable active site. Crews, Deshaies and Handa map onto distinct, citable steps (bifunctional concept; cereblon as the shared ligase explaining the glues), and the citation covers both strands under one principle. The main cost is timing before an approved degrader and the omission of Ciulli, Sakamoto, Kim and Gray. P002 is a mature, cleanly attributed ligand-design achievement but an extension of the 2010 cross-coupling prize, and P003 is mature but entangled in platform credit and the border with medicine, so both rank below P001 and above no award.
